rationale: Price is at 92.5% of today's range and within 0.87% of the session high after a strong intraday recovery from $66.90 to $75.06, but momentum is visibly stalling — the last three 1-minute candles show declining volume and a tight, compressing range near $75.22–75.42 with no clear breakout or rejection.
